def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive access
    player = observation.get("player", {})
    grid = observation.get("grid", {})
    mode = observation.get("mode", None)

    # Default safe move
    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Try to infer simple objective from mode
    if mode == "resource_collection":
        # Move toward nearest resource if available
        resources = observation.get("resources") or []
        px = player.get("x", 0)
        py = player.get("y", 0)
        best = None
        best_dist = float("inf")
        for r in resources:
            rx = r.get("x", 0)
            ry = r.get("y", 0)
            dist = abs(px - rx) + abs(py - ry)
            if dist < best_dist:
                best_dist = dist
                best = (rx, ry)
        if best is not None:
            rx, ry = best
            dx = 1 if rx > px else (-1 if rx < px else 0)
            dy = 1 if ry > py else (-1 if ry < py else 0)
            if dx == 0 and dy == 0:
                dx, dy = 0, 0
        return [dx, dy]

    if mode == "pursuit_evasion":
        # Move away from nearest threat if any
        threats = observation.get("threats") or []
        px = player.get("x", 0)
        py = player.get("y", 0)
        if threats:
            # find closest threat
            best = None
            best_dist = float("inf")
            for t in threats:
                tx = t.get("x", 0)
                ty = t.get("y", 0)
                dist = abs(px - tx) + abs(py - ty)
                if dist < best_dist:
                    best_dist = dist
                    best = (tx, ty)
            if best is not None:
                tx, ty = best
                dx = -1 if tx > px else (1 if tx < px else 0)
                dy = -1 if ty > py else (1 if ty < py else 0)
                return [dx, dy]
        # no threat info, drift randomly within safe bounds
        return [0, 0]

    if mode == "territory_control":
        # Move toward neutral/empty nearby cell or own border
        px = player.get("x", 0)
        py = player.get("y", 0)
        grid_w = grid.get("width", 0)
        grid_h = grid.get("height", 0)
        # prioritize center-ish movement if grid unknown
        cx = observation.get("center_x", grid_w // 2 if grid_w else 0)
        cy = observation.get("center_y", grid_h // 2 if grid_h else 0)
        dx = 1 if cx > px else (-1 if cx < px else 0)
        dy = 1 if cy > py else (-1 if cy < py else 0)
        # clamp to -1,0,1 implicitly
        return [dx, dy]

    # Fallback: move toward closest cell that is within bounds if information missing
    px = player.get("x", 0)
    py = player.get("y", 0)
    dx = 0
    dy = 0
    if grid:
        w = grid.get("width", 0)
        h = grid.get("height", 0)
        if w:
            dx = 1 if (px + 1) < w else ( -1 if (px - 1) >= 0 else 0 )
        if h:
            dy = 1 if (py + 1) < h else ( -1 if (py - 1) >= 0 else 0 )
    return [dx, dy]
